local_git_history.note: Email identities are not verified people. Obvious automation identities were excluded, but AI-assisted and shared identities cannot be reliably classified.

install.boundary: Base source-development path only; complete data, production self-hosting, and desktop binaries were not verified.

dependency_audit.note: Advisory count is not a reachability or exploitability analysis.

desktop_release.observed_failure_reason: Required build-time configuration values were absent, so the workflow refused to ship a degraded desktop build.

independent_adoption.evidence: The independent repository calls api.worldmonitor.app in application configuration and credits World Monitor as inspiration.
independent_adoption.note: This proves at least one real public integration, not broad organizational adoption.

a_grade_blockers: Published desktop releases lag current source and recent desktop build attempts are failing.
Recent contribution remains highly concentrated in the repository owner.
Independent downstream adoption is real but too thin to establish broad, stable usage.
Production self-hosting has a material operational and credential footprint.
